scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src=fs.existsSync('frontend/.output/public')?'frontend/.output/public':(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')?'frontend/dist':null); if(src){fs.cpSync(src, 'public', {recursive: true}); console.log('Copied output to root public/ folder!');}"
